{{nihongo|'''Karakawa Shrine'''|賀羅加波神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Bingo Province]].

'''Karakawa Shrine''' (からかわじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} located in Nakanomachi, {{ill|Mihara, Hiroshima|ar|ميهارا (هيروشيما)|azb|میهارا، هیروشیما|ce|Михара (гӀала)|ceb|Mihara (lungsod sa Hapon)|cs|Mihara (Hirošima)|de|Mihara|eo|Mihara|es|Mihara (Hiroshima)|fa|میهارا، هیروشیما|fi|Mihara|fr|Mihara|gl|Mihara|he|מיהארה|id|Mihara, Hiroshima|it|Mihara|ja|三原市|ko|미하라시|mzn|میهارا، هیروشیما|nl|Mihara|pl|Mihara|pt|Mihara|ro|Mihara|ru|Михара (город)|sh|Mihara|sr|Михара|sv|Mihara|szl|Mihara|tg|Миҳара|th|มิฮาระ|tl|Mihara, Hiroshima|tr|Mihara|tt|Михара (шәһәр)|uk|Міхара (Хіросіма)|ur|میہارا، ہیروشیما|vi|Mihara, Hiroshima|war|Mihara, Hiroshima|zh|三原市|zh_classical|三原市|zh_min_nan|Mihara-chhī|zh_yue|三原市|qid=Q820760}}, {{ill|Hiroshima Prefecture|Q617375|qid=Q617375}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}, and under the {{ill|Q712534|lt=former shrine ranking}} it was classified as a {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}.

In the *{{ill|Engishiki|Q1342448|qid=Q1342448}}* {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Register of Deities}}, compiled in the 5th year of {{ill|Enchō|de|Enchō|fa|انچو|fr|Ère Enchō|ia|Encho|id|Enchō|ja|延長 (元号)|ko|엔초|ru|Энтё|simple|Enchō|sr|Енчо|tr|Enchō|uk|Ентьо|zh|延長 (日本)|zh_yue|延長 (年號)|qid=Q1327274|lt=Engi}} ({{ill|927|ab|927|af|927|am|927 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|927|ar|927|ary|927|ast|927|avk|927|az|927|azb|۹۲۷ (میلادی)|bar|927|bcl|927|be|927|be_x_old|927|bg|927|bn|৯২৭|bpy|মারি ৯২৭|br|927|bs|927.|ca|927|cdo|927 nièng|ceb|927|ckb|٩٢٧|crh|927|cs|927|csb|927|cv|927|cy|927|da|927|de|927|el|927|eml|927|eo|927|es|927|et|927|eu|927|fa|۹۲۷ (میلادی)|fi|927|fo|927|fr|927|fy|927|ga|927|gan|927年|gd|927|gl|927|he|927|hi|927|hr|927.|ht|927 (almanak jilyen)|hu|927|hy|927|id|927|ilo|927|io|927|is|927|it|927|ja|927年|jv|927|ka|927|kaa|927|kk|927 жыл|ko|927년|la|927|lb|927|lij|927|lmo|927|lt|927 m.|lv|927. gads|map_bms|927|mdf|927|mg|927|mhr|927|mi|927|mk|927|mr|इ.स. ९२७|mrj|927 и|ms|927|mzn|۹۲۷|nah|927|nap|927|nds|927|new|सन् ९२७|nl|927|nn|927|no|927|nrm|927|nso|927|oc|927|or|୯୨୭|os|927-æм аз|pl|927|pnb|927|pt|927|qu|927|ro|927|ru|927 год|rue|927|sa|९२७|scn|927|sd|927ع|se|927|sh|927.|shn|927|si|927|sk|927|smn|927|sq|927|sr|927|su|927|sv|927|sw|927|tg|Соли 927|th|พ.ศ. 1470|tk|927|tl|927|tly|927|tr|927|tt|927 ел|uk|927|ur|927ء|uz|927|vec|927|vi|927|war|927|wuu|927年|xmf|927|zh|927年|zh_min_nan|927 nî|zh_yue|927年|qid=Q30470}}), only one deity is listed<ref>{{Sfn|Karakawa Shrine (Shikinaisha)|1980}}</ref>. It is said that the shrine name “Karakawa” (賀羅加波) derives from the Wakura River flowing underground near the shrine, where it was called a “dry river” (karakawa)<ref name="由緒書"/><ref>{{Sfn|Karakawa Shrine (Shikinaisha)|1980}}</ref>. There is also a theory that, based on the sound “kara,” it was a shrine of immigrant groups from the Korean Peninsula<ref>{{Sfn|Karakawa Shrine (Shikinaisha)|1980}}</ref>.

The {{ill|Shintai|de|Shintai|el|Σίνταϊ|es|Shintai|fa|شین‌تای|fi|Shintai|fr|Shintai|hr|Shintai|id|Shintai|ja|神体|jv|Shintai|ko|신체 (신토)|mk|Шинтаи|pl|Go-shintai|pt|Shintai|ru|Синтай (синтоизм)|simple|Shintai|sr|Шинтаи|tr|Shintai|uk|Сінтай (синто)|zh|神體|qid=Q327532}} is a wooden statue and is said to have been dedicated by imperial command<ref name="由緒書"/>.

=== History ===
The date of foundation is unknown<ref name="由緒書"/>.

In the *{{ill|Engishiki|Q1342448|qid=Q1342448}}* {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Register of Deities}}, compiled in the 5th year of {{ill|Enchō|de|Enchō|fa|انچو|fr|Ère Enchō|ia|Encho|id|Enchō|ja|延長 (元号)|ko|엔초|ru|Энтё|simple|Enchō|sr|Енчо|tr|Enchō|uk|Ентьо|zh|延長 (日本)|zh_yue|延長 (年號)|qid=Q1327274|lt=Engi}} ({{ill|927|ab|927|af|927|am|927 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|927|ar|927|ary|927|ast|927|avk|927|az|927|azb|۹۲۷ (میلادی)|bar|927|bcl|927|be|927|be_x_old|927|bg|927|bn|৯২৭|bpy|মারি ৯২৭|br|927|bs|927.|ca|927|cdo|927 nièng|ceb|927|ckb|٩٢٧|crh|927|cs|927|csb|927|cv|927|cy|927|da|927|de|927|el|927|eml|927|eo|927|es|927|et|927|eu|927|fa|۹۲۷ (میلادی)|fi|927|fo|927|fr|927|fy|927|ga|927|gan|927年|gd|927|gl|927|he|927|hi|927|hr|927.|ht|927 (almanak jilyen)|hu|927|hy|927|id|927|ilo|927|io|927|is|927|it|927|ja|927年|jv|927|ka|927|kaa|927|kk|927 жыл|ko|927년|la|927|lb|927|lij|927|lmo|927|lt|927 m.|lv|927. gads|map_bms|927|mdf|927|mg|927|mhr|927|mi|927|mk|927|mr|इ.स. ९२७|mrj|927 и|ms|927|mzn|۹۲۷|nah|927|nap|927|nds|927|new|सन् ९२७|nl|927|nn|927|no|927|nrm|927|nso|927|oc|927|or|୯୨୭|os|927-æм аз|pl|927|pnb|927|pt|927|qu|927|ro|927|ru|927 год|rue|927|sa|९२७|scn|927|sd|927ع|se|927|sh|927.|shn|927|si|927|sk|927|smn|927|sq|927|sr|927|su|927|sv|927|sw|927|tg|Соли 927|th|พ.ศ. 1470|tk|927|tl|927|tly|927|tr|927|tt|927 ел|uk|927|ur|927ء|uz|927|vec|927|vi|927|war|927|wuu|927年|xmf|927|zh|927年|zh_min_nan|927 nî|zh_yue|927年|qid=Q30470}}), the shrine is listed as “Karakawa Shrine” in Mitsugi District of Bingo Province and is ranked as a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} (the only Shikinaisha in Mitsugi District)<ref>{{Sfn|Karakawa Shrine (Shikinaisha)|1980}}</ref>.

According to the *Kokugunshi Shitagechō Shutsuchō*, until the time of {{ill|Kobayakawa Takakage|Q1143508|qid=Q1143508}}, the shrine possessed 5–6 chō of shrine land nearby, but this was confiscated during the time of {{ill|Fukushima Masanori|Q1194995|qid=Q1194995}}<ref>{{Sfn|Karakawa Shrine (Heibonsha)|1982}}</ref>. It is also said that Fukushima Masanori ordered Oni Genbei to cut down a large camphor tree in the shrine precincts, and that all seven members of Oni Genbei’s family died within that year after the tree was felled<ref>{{Sfn|Karakawa Shrine (Heibonsha)|1982}}</ref>.

After the {{ill|Meiji Restoration|Q8707|qid=Q8707}}, in the 6th year of {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}} ({{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}}), the shrine was ranked as a {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}} under the {{ill|Q712534|lt=Modern shrine ranking system}}<ref name="由緒書"/>.

=== Auxiliary and subordinate shrines ===
[[File:Karakawa-jinja, keidaisha.jpg|thumb|220px|right|{{center|Shrines within the precincts}}]]
* Yadori Shrine – Enshrined deities: {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|Q272993|qid=Q272993|lt=Susanoo-no-Mikoto}} and {{ill|Somin Shōrai|Q7560421|qid=Q7560421|lt=Somin Shōrai-no-Mikoto}}.
* Takura Shrine – Enshrined deities: Yaoyorozu no Ōkami. A collective enshrinement of more than 70 shrines, including Karakawa, Sadakane, Mitsutani, Tsunenaga, Ushiroyama, Kuranouchi, Shigeta, Jūichimen, Shigemasa, Ōtani, and others.

=== Festivals ===
The annual festivals held at Karakawa Shrine are as follows<ref name="由緒書"/>:
* Daily offerings festival (every day)
* Monthly festival (1st and 15th of each month)
* New Year’s Day Festival ({{ill|January 1|Q2150|qid=Q2150}}) – prayers for the New Year
* Sagichō Festival / Old talisman burning festival (around {{ill|January 14|Q2257|qid=Q2257}})
* Setsubun Festival ({{ill|February 3|Q2315|qid=Q2315}}) – exorcism of misfortune, Chinowa ritual, Hisha Shinji
*: Regarding the special ritual Hisha Shinji, the *{{ill|Geihan Tsuushi|Q11615959|qid=Q11615959}}* records that after shooting arrows made from plum wood toward the northeast (the demon gate), a target marked with the character for “demon” is shot, after which worshippers each shoot one arrow<ref name="由緒書"/>.
* Kinen-sai ({{ill|February 17|Q2341|qid=Q2341}})
* Spring Grand Festival (first Sunday of April)
* Summer Purification ({{ill|June 30|Q2657|qid=Q2657}}) – Chinowa ritual
* Annual Grand Festival (October, {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Health and Sports Day}})
* Niiname-sai ({{ill|November 23|Q3021|qid=Q3021}})
* Great Purification, New Year’s Eve Festival, Chinka Festival ({{ill|December 31|Q2912|qid=Q2912}})

=== Cultural properties ===
=== Designated cultural properties of Mihara City ===
* Natural Monument
** Ginkgo tree of Karakawa Shrine – trunk circumference at breast height: 4.16 meters; tree height: 33.6 meters. Designated on February 20, 2013 (Heisei 25)<ref>“Ginkgo Tree of Karakawa Shrine,” *Cultural Properties of Mihara City*, Mihara City Board of Education, 2016.</ref>.
